can_do: I can point to and say snack words.
kp_target: VOC: snack words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
lesson_input: Look. Listen. Point. | apple · banana · orange · sandwich · cookie | Extra picture words: cake, bread. These are look-and-say words only.
repair_link: If you are not sure, look at the tray again and say one word only.

can_do: I can say what snack I want.
kp_target: CHK: I want ...; VOC: snack choice; SI: answer a simple choice question
lesson_input: Listen. Choose. Say. | I want an apple. | I want a banana. | I want a sandwich. | I want a cookie.
repair_link: Start with the chunk I want. Then add one snack word.

can_do: I can ask for a snack politely.
kp_target: CHK: I want ..., please.; REG: friendly polite asking; SI: helper/learner exchange
lesson_input: Polite snack words: | I want a banana, please. | I want an apple, please. | Thank you.
repair_link: If please is missing, say the whole line again with please at the end.

can_do: I can notice and use fixed snack chunks: a banana, an apple.
kp_target: GRM: a/an noticing as fixed chunks only; VOC: snack chunks; STR: repair by model copying
lesson_input: Listen and copy the chunk. Do not explain it. Just say it. | a banana · a sandwich · a cookie | an apple · an orange
repair_link: Use the repair picture. Copy the full chunk, not only the food word.

can_do: I can name simple drinks and choose one drink.
kp_target: VOC: drink words; CHK: I want water/milk/juice, please.; SI: simple choice
lesson_input: Drink words: | water · milk · juice | I want water, please. | I want milk, please. | I want juice, please.
repair_link: For drinks, use the drink word after I want: I want juice, please.

can_do: I can ask for one snack and one drink in a short role-play.
kp_target: SI: snack order role-play; CHK: I want ..., please.; VOC: snack + drink; REG: thank you
lesson_input: Role-play model: | Helper: Hello. | Learner: I want an apple and water, please. | Helper: Here you are. | Learner: Thank you.
repair_link: If the line is too long, say it in two parts: I want a sandwich. I want juice, please.

can_do: I can make and rehearse my snack order card.
kp_target: PRJ: project rehearsal; SP: short snack order; WRT: copy one snack word and one drink word; STR: self-check
lesson_input: Project model card: | My snack: an apple. | My drink: water. | My line: I want an apple and water, please.
repair_link: Check three parts: snack word, drink word, please.
portfolio_link: photo of snack order card + short speaking recording of the role-play

can_do: I can understand a short snack choice video.
kp_target: LST: main idea, simple detail, sequence; CHK: I want ..., please.
lesson_input: A short Pre-A1 snack-choice story. Leo, Mia, and Emma choose one snack or drink politely while Toto watches the snack card.
repair_link: Replay with captions and copy one line.

can_do: I can say my snack order politely.
repair_link: Use project checklist and retry line.
